definition: A generative model trained to reverse a process that gradually adds noise to data, thereby learning to create new data from noise.
details: Training adds Gaussian noise over many steps until an image becomes pure noise, and the network learns to predict and remove the noise at each step. Sampling then starts from random noise and denoises it step by step. Diffusion models power modern text-to-image systems such as DALL·E, Stable Diffusion and Midjourney.

citation.title: Denoising Diffusion Probabilistic Models
